_what_this_is: the ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE enhancement family as RECORDS — 15 active members plus one BAdI, each with the gate it keys on, where it fires, and what it modifies
_why_structured: this analysis existed and was excellent, in 767 lines of markdown with a 15-row table. Nothing could query it: not 'which members are posting-currency-anchored', not 'which hooks persist versus which only affect an in-memory check', not 'which are dead'. A table a human reads is not a table an algorithm reads.
_the_finding_in_one_line: the members disagree about what THE CONSUMPTION CURRENCY IS. Camp A keys on the reservation's own currency and fires regardless of how it is consumed; Camp B keys on the currency of the row being persisted and skips when they differ. A USD posting against an EUR reservation satisfies A and fails B, so half the family converts and half does not.

_what_a_reader_should_take_from_this: FIFTEEN members and only SIX persist. Half the family exists to make in-memory checks pass, which is why an availability check can succeed while the stored figures drift.
The camps are the defect. A USD posting against an EUR reservation satisfies every Camp A gate and fails every Camp B gate, so the reservation side converts and the consumption side does not.
The escape hatch is scoped to symptoms, not to the mechanism: the AVC-skip BAdI covers MIRO and F110 and leaves FB60 exposed.
The carryforward branch (1b) decides how last year's balances arrive this year, so the drift is inherited across years rather than reset.

three_gates_not_one._the_finding: the class carries THREE condition methods with THREE different range sets, and the difference between them is where the asymmetry lives.

CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._note: the cure for the currency defect EXISTS in this variant and is unreachable from the main path — the staff gate accepts USD, the main one does not
CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._second_latent_defect: this gate also checks IV_HKONT IN MR_HKONT, and MR_HKONT is DECLARED at line 57 and NEVER POPULATED anywhere in the class. In ABAP a value IN an empty range is FALSE, so whenever a GL account is passed the staff gate FAILS ALWAYS. Same shape as the known defect: a range that gates and is never filled.
CHECK_CONDITIONS_2._second_latent_defect_QUALIFIED: QUALIFIED after reading the production source properly. IV_HKONT is declared OPTIONAL and the check is guarded by IF IV_HKONT IS NOT INITIAL — so the empty-range trap fires ONLY if a caller passes a GL account. And CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 has NO CALLER anywhere in the extracted corpus: only its implementation (line 336) and its declaration (line 573). WHICH RAISES A BIGGER QUESTION THAN THE TRAP: is the STAFF gate used at all? The callers would be in the ENHO members, and THE ENHANCEMENTS ARE NOT IN THE CORPUS — the extractor handles CLAS, PROG and FUGR only, so all 12 ZFIX enhancement implementations are unread. Zero ZFIX files in extracted_sap_p01/YA. Until they are read, 'the staff path is dead' and 'the staff path is never called' are indistinguishable, and both would explain why USD postings never convert.

CHECK_CONDITIONS_3.logic: INVERTED: NOT IN for ledger, company, FM area and business area; and IN for the *3 variants, which INCLUDE GAINS/REVENUE and INCLUDE HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 and EXCLUDE the ZZFIX_RATE fund types

how_the_mechanism_actually_writes._the_correction: I described this as a PARALLEL LEDGER: a shadow set of tables holding the fixed-rate valuation of every FM line. THAT IS WRONG, and it was wrong in the way that matters — I inferred it from YCL_FI_BR_UPDATE_TABLES having UPDATE and INSERT methods against YTFM_BR_* tables, and never checked whether those tables contained anything.
how_the_mechanism_actually_writes._what_actually_happens: the BR solution MODIFIES THE STANDARD POSTING. The enhancements change the value AT THE MOMENT OF POSTING, so the fixed-rate amount lands in the standard FM tables themselves. There is no second ledger to reconcile against — which is why the PERIMETER and the GATES are the whole mechanism: they decide, per posting, whether the value is converted before it is written.

the_exact_perimeter._the_semantics_that_make_this_not_a_filt: EVERY check in CHECK_CONDITIONS is wrapped in IF IV_xxx IS NOT INITIAL. A parameter the caller leaves EMPTY SKIPS ITS CONDITION ENTIRELY. So the effective perimeter is not the eight ranges — it is whichever of the eight the caller actually supplies. Two callers passing different subsets get different perimeters from the same class, and nothing in the class records which. This is why the perimeter cannot be reproduced as a WHERE clause over the FM lines and why any measurement built that way is an approximation.

the_twelve_moments._what_this_is: WHERE the budget rate hooks into SAP and WHEN it fires. The conditions were already known; this is the other half — the moments. Read from the enhancement sources themselves, extracted from P01.
the_twelve_moments._how_they_were_read: an ENHO has no program of its own: its source lives in a GENERATED INCLUDE named <ENHNAME> padded to 30 characters with '=' then 'E'. ENHOBJ gives the hooked object and ENHINCINX gives the include. Once the include name is right, RPY_PROGRAM_READ reads it like any program — the extractor had been skipping ENHO as unreadable.
the_twelve_moments._the_finding_that_matters_most: NO TWO CALL SITES PASS THE SAME SET OF CONDITIONS, and every unpassed parameter SKIPS its check. So the perimeter is not one perimeter — it is twelve, one per moment. The extreme case is REVALUATION, which passes ONLY the fund type: at that moment there is no currency restriction, no business area, no commitment item and no business transaction. The EUR-only limit that shapes everything else does not apply there.
the_twelve_moments._the_staff_path_is_separate: PBC position update and employee expense posting do not use the main perimeter at all. They gate through YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL and YCL_FM_BR_PAYROLL_POSTING_BL, on PERNR, and convert through CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY_2.

the_conversion.designed: CONVERT_TO_BUDGET_RATE: amount to EUR at rate type M (the operational rate), then that EUR amount to USD at rate type EURX
the_conversion.STATUS: DEAD CODE — both call sites sit inside IF 1 = 2 in ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_PBC_POS_UPD
the_conversion.what_runs_instead: CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY_2 on YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL, guarded by IF CS_POS-WAERS = 'USD'
the_conversion.the_comment_that_explains_it: ALL PBC Documents are in USD. Even if postings are in EUR.

the_trace._reading: consistent with the path being largely switched off, though 'not reached' and 'not landing' have not been separated

personnel.STATUS: BR FOR STAFF — computed in the PAYROLL ENGINE, carried by 72 'Constant Dollar' wage types. Distinct from the FM-side pilot objects below.

the_real_mechanism.where: the payroll engine, country grouping UN (UNESCO's own MOLGA)
the_real_mechanism.carried_by: 72 wage types named 'Constant Dollar for <base wage type>'
the_real_mechanism.pattern: each 9xxx mirrors a base wage type valued at the fixed rate
the_real_mechanism._the_name_ties_it_to_FM: 'Constant Dollar' is exactly what the FM reporting programs are called — YFM_CONSTANT_DOLLAR and its two variants. One concept, implemented twice
the_real_mechanism._how_it_was_found: NOT in the schemas — no custom step names it, and the 'ABR' hits are the payroll program indicator. NOT in the rule content — 166,453 rule lines searched for EURX/BUDGET/CDR gave one false positive. The mechanism is named after its OUTPUT, so the wage-type catalogue is where it surfaces

posting_configuration.status: CONFIGURED — all 72 Constant Dollar wage types are in T52EL under MOLGA 'UN'
posting_configuration._correction: reported earlier as 'T52EL empty for UN'. The table was simply not in the golden and the live query was malformed. T52EL holds 6,735 rows across 32 country groupings including UN

the_real_mechanism._what_remains: the AMOUNT — the staff-cost equivalent of the -2,365,688.44 USD measured on the non-personnel side

the_payroll_posting_path._note: each run written twice, document types P1 and P2
the_payroll_posting_path._the_70_outside: most likely leavers — the perimeter was computed on CURRENT org assignments, so anyone who left since January 2025 drops out. A limitation of the comparison, not a gate failure

the_shape_is_a_test._reading: four single-digit probes, one bulk run of 634 and one of 60, inside ten days

the_pbc_position_path._why: both CONVERT_TO_BUDGET_RATE call sites sit inside IF 1 = 2

the_fm_side_pilot_objects._the_currency_condition_is_not_the_block: PBC commitment lines in FMIOI carry USD on 1,207,981 rows against ~4,000 in BRL, so IF CS_POS-WAERS = 'USD' is satisfied. The code comment 'ALL PBC Documents are in USD' is correct
the_fm_side_pilot_objects._what_it_means_for_the_impact: staff cost is essentially NOT being valued at the budget rate in FM: one month of amounts across 703 rows, and nothing else. Whatever the payroll schema computes upstream, it is not reaching FM as a budget-rate valuation

the_driver.class: YCL_FM_BR_POSTING_IN_FM_BL — 991 lines, driven by payroll RUNID
the_driver._the_contrast: the CONTROL report YFM_FI_COMPARE_INCLUDING_BR ran 43 times by 5 users in the same window. The control outlived the thing it was built to control

payroll_itself_never_stopped.fmreserv_change_docs: every month through 2026-03; 542,018 in Jan 2024, 486,651 in Jan 2026
payroll_itself_never_stopped._reading: payroll ran throughout; only the budget-rate layer above it did not

the_fm_side_pilot_objects._scope_note: these are the FM-SIDE artefacts — a pilot never adopted. They are NOT the staff budget rate, which lives in the payroll engine above

_THE_HEADLINE: THE BUDGET RATE IS ONE CONCEPT IMPLEMENTED TWICE. Non-personnel: eight ranges, twelve moments, exchange rate type EURX, running at 94.7% of its perimeter and producing a measurable -2,365,688.44 USD on financial postings. Staff: computed in the PAYROLL ENGINE and carried by 72 'Constant Dollar' wage types in country grouping UN — a different gate (HR feature YYCDR), a different mechanism, and not yet measured. A separate set of FM-side objects exists to post the staff figure and was piloted once in January 2025 and never adopted.
